```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, out.width = "100%")
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
theme_set(theme_bw())
pd <- position_dodge(0.5)

# Read in simulation parms (and pop truth) -----
load("./simdata/simParms.RData")
parms <- parms %>%
  dplyr::select(pop, mech, sampsize,
                rho_ya.z, or_y, or_a,
                mu)

# Read in all estimators ----
getres <- function(x)
{
  load(x)
  return(res)
}

# PPMM-Reg
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "ppmmreg_")
stack_ppmmreg <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  # filter to only SRS
  filter(probtype == "SRS") %>%
  # filter to only P > NP
  filter(sampsize == 1) %>%
  # filter to only original 9 NP selection mechanisms
  filter(mech <= 9) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(est_NP:ub_NP, num_s_equals_1))

# PPMM-Reg using alternative covariates - set A
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "ppmmregmisA")
stack_ppmmregmisA <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  dplyr::select(-num_s_equals_1)

# PPMM-Reg using alternative covariates - set B
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "ppmmregmisB")
stack_ppmmregmisB <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  dplyr::select(-num_s_equals_1)

# Merge estimators -----
all <- stack_ppmmreg %>%
  left_join(stack_ppmmregmisA) %>%
  left_join(stack_ppmmregmisB)

rm(stack_ppmmreg, stack_ppmmregmisA, stack_ppmmregmisB, filelist, getres)

# Make long and merge in parms -----
long <- all %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(starts_with("se"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(probtype, pop, mech, sampsize, rep), 
               names_to = c(".value", "method"), 
               names_sep="_" ) %>%
  left_join(parms) %>%
  mutate(bias = est - mu,
         relbias = bias/mu,
         cover = (lb < mu & ub > mu),
         width = ub - lb) 

# summarize across replicates
sumstats <- long %>%
  group_by(probtype, pop, mech, sampsize, mu, rho_ya.z, or_y, or_a, method) %>%
  summarize(nreps = n(), 
            mean_bias = mean(bias),
            sd_bias = sd(bias),
            lb_bias = mean_bias - 1.96*sd_bias/sqrt(nreps),
            ub_bias = mean_bias + 1.96*sd_bias/sqrt(nreps),
            mean_cover = mean(cover),
            sd_cover = sqrt(mean_cover*(1-mean_cover)),
            lb_cover = pmax(0, mean_cover - 1.96*sd_cover/sqrt(nreps)),
            ub_cover = pmin(1, mean_cover + 1.96*sd_cover/sqrt(nreps)),
            mean_width = mean(width),
            median_width = median(width))
sumstats <- sumstats %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(relbias = 100*mean_bias/mu,
         phi_value = case_when(method %in% c("ppmmreg0","ppmmregmisA0","ppmmregmisB0") ~ "\u03c6=0",
                               method %in% c("ppmmreg1","ppmmregmisA1","ppmmregmisB1") ~ "\u03c6=1",
                               method %in% c("ppmmreg", "ppmmregmisA", "ppmmregmisB") ~ "\u03c6~Uniform(0,1)"),
         covariates = case_when(method %in% c("ppmmreg0", 
                                              "ppmmreg1", 
                                              "ppmmreg") ~ "Proxy = A, Covars = Z1 + Z2",
                                method %in% c("ppmmregmisA0", 
                                              "ppmmregmisA1", 
                                              "ppmmregmisA") ~ "Proxy = Z2, Covars = Z1 + A",
                                method %in% c("ppmmregmisB0",
                                              "ppmmregmisB1",
                                              "ppmmregmisB") ~ "Proxy = Z2, Covars = Z1"),
         covariates = factor(covariates, levels = c("Proxy = A, Covars = Z1 + Z2",
                                                    "Proxy = Z2, Covars = Z1 + A",
                                                    "Proxy = Z2, Covars = Z1")),
         set = case_when(or_y == 1 & or_a == 1 ~ 1,
                         or_y == 1 & or_a != 1 ~ 2,
                         or_y != 1 & or_a == 1 ~ 3,
                         or_y != 1 & or_a != 1 ~ 4),
         set_f = case_when(set == 1 ~ "Set 1: Ignorable w/Shadow Var",
                           set == 2 ~ "Set 2: Ignorable w/o Shadow Var",
                           set == 3 ~ "Set 3: Nonignorable w/Shadow Var",
                           set == 4 ~ "Set 4: Nonignorable w/o Shadow Var"))


# labels for facets
rho_ya.z.labs <- c("Cor(Y,A|Z) = 0.2", "Cor(Y,A|Z) = 0.5", "Cor(Y,A|Z) = 0.8")
names(rho_ya.z.labs) <- c("0.2", "0.5", "0.8")
or_a.labs <- c("OR(A) = 1", "OR(A) = 1.1", "OR(A) = 2")
names(or_a.labs) <- c(1, 1.1, 2)
or_y.labs <- c("OR(Y) = 1", "OR(Y) = 1.1", "OR(Y) = 2")
names(or_y.labs) <- c(1, 1.1, 2)

# Also get the proxy strength estimates
load("./simresults/rhohat_ppmmreg.RData")
rhohat_long <- rhohat %>%
  filter(sampsize == 2) %>%
  left_join(parms) %>%
  mutate(set = case_when(or_y == 1 & or_a == 1 ~ 1,
                         or_y == 1 & or_a != 1 ~ 2,
                         or_y != 1 & or_a == 1 ~ 3,
                         or_y != 1 & or_a != 1 ~ 4),
         set_f = case_when(set == 1 ~ "Set 1: Ignorable w/Shadow Var",
                           set == 2 ~ "Set 2: Ignorable w/o Shadow Var",
                           set == 3 ~ "Set 3: Nonignorable w/Shadow Var",
                           set == 4 ~ "Set 4: Nonignorable w/o Shadow Var")) %>%
  pivot_longer(contains("rhohat"), names_to = "model", values_to = "rhohat", names_prefix = "rhohat_") %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("orig", "misA", "misB"),
                        labels = c("Proxy = A, Covars = Z1 + Z2",
                                   "Proxy = Z2, Covars = Z1 + A",
                                   "Proxy = Z2, Covars = Z1")))
```

### Proxy strength for the different PPMM-Reg specifications

```{r, fig.asp=0.3}
g <- rhohat_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = factor(pop), x = rhohat, color = model, shape = model)) + 
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(.~or_y+or_a, space = "free", labeller = labeller(or_y = or_y.labs, or_a = or_a.labs)) +
  labs(y = "Population", x = "Proxy Strength", color = "", shape = "") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10)) + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.1, 0.9)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8)) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2")
g_rho1 <- g + filter(rhohat_long, set == 1) + ggtitle("Ignorable, A is a Shadow Variable")
g_rho2 <- g + filter(rhohat_long, set == 2) + ggtitle("Ignorable, A is NOT a Shadow Variable")
g_rho3 <- g + filter(rhohat_long, set == 3) + ggtitle("Non-Ignorable, A is a Shadow Variable")
g_rho4 <- g + filter(rhohat_long, set == 4) + ggtitle("Non-Ignorable, A is NOT a Shadow Variable")
```

Estimated from the scenarios with NP > P

```{r}
ggpubr::ggarrange(g_rho1, g_rho2, g_rho3, g_rho4, common.legend = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Bias plot
g_bias <- sumstats %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(covariates), x = mean_bias, color = factor(rho_ya.z), shape = factor(rho_ya.z))) + 
  geom_point(size = 1, position = pd) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lb_bias, xmax = ub_bias), position = pd, width = 0.3) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") + 
  labs(x = "Empirical Bias", y = " ", color = "Cor(Y,A|Z)", shape = "Cor(Y,A|Z)") + 
  ggh4x::facet_nested(phi_value ~ or_y + or_a, 
                      labeller = labeller(or_y = or_y.labs, or_a = or_a.labs),
                      scales = "free", space = "free_y")  + 
  theme(strip.background.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0,"cm")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# ignorable
g_bias1 <- g_bias + filter(sumstats, or_y == 1)
# nonignorable w/shadow var
g_bias2 <- g_bias + filter(sumstats, or_y > 1 & or_a == 1) + 
  ggh4x::facet_nested(phi_value ~ or_a + or_y, 
                      labeller = labeller(or_y = or_y.labs, or_a = or_a.labs),
                      scales = "free", space = "free_y")
# nonignorable no shadow var
g_bias3 <- g_bias + filter(sumstats, or_y > 1 & or_a > 1)

# Coverage plot
g_cov <- sumstats %>%
  # filter(!is.na(mean_cover)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(covariates), x = mean_cover, color = factor(rho_ya.z), shape = factor(rho_ya.z))) + 
  geom_point(size = 1, position = pd) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lb_cover, xmax = ub_cover), position = pd, width = 0.2) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.95, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") + 
  labs(x = "Empirical Coverage of 95% Intervals", y = " ", color = "Cor(Y,A|Z)", shape = "Cor(Y,A|Z)") + 
  theme(legend.position = "right") + 
  ggh4x::facet_nested(phi_value ~ or_y + or_a, 
                      labeller = labeller(or_y = or_y.labs, or_a = or_a.labs),
                      scales = "free", space = "free_y") + 
  theme(strip.background.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0,"cm")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
g_cov1 <- g_cov + filter(sumstats, or_y == 1)
g_cov2 <- g_cov + filter(sumstats, or_y > 1 & or_a == 1) + 
  ggh4x::facet_nested(phi_value ~ or_a + or_y, 
                      labeller = labeller(or_y = or_y.labs, or_a = or_a.labs),
                      scales = "free", space = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
g_cov3 <- g_cov + filter(sumstats, or_y > 1 & or_a > 1)

# CI Width plot
g_wid <- sumstats %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(covariates), x = median_width, color = factor(rho_ya.z), shape = factor(rho_ya.z))) + 
  geom_point(size = 1, position = pd) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = median_width), position = pd, width = 0, orientation = "y") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 1, color = "grey50") + 
  labs(x = "Median CI Width", y = " ", color = "Cor(Y,A|Z)", shape = "Cor(Y,A|Z)") + 
  theme(legend.position = "right") + 
  ggh4x::facet_nested(phi_value ~ or_y + or_a, 
                      labeller = labeller(or_y = or_y.labs, or_a = or_a.labs),
                      scales = "free", space = "free_y") + 
  theme(strip.background.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0,"cm")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
g_wid1 <- g_wid + filter(sumstats, or_y == 1)
g_wid2 <- g_wid + filter(sumstats, or_y > 1 & or_a == 1) + 
  ggh4x::facet_nested(phi_value ~ or_a + or_y, 
                      labeller = labeller(or_y = or_y.labs, or_a = or_a.labs),
                      scales = "free", space = "free_y")
g_wid3 <- g_wid + filter(sumstats, or_y > 1 & or_a > 1)
```

### Ignorable {.tabset}

OR(Y) = 1

-   When OR(A) = 1:
    -   Since A is not associated with selection (after conditioning on Z1 & Z2), leaving it out of the PPMM-Reg approach doesn't lead to bias
    -   True $\phi$ = 0 for all three specifications of the model
    -   Thus, all are unbiased for $\phi=0$
-   When OR(A) > 1:
    -   True $\phi$ = 0 when A is included in the model (either as the proxy or as a covariate)
    -   Excluding A leads to bias b/c A is being ignored but it is associated with selection
    -   Thus, only the models that include A will be unbiased (with $\phi=0$)

```{r, fig.asp=0.5}
g_bias1
```


### Non-Ignorable, A is a Shadow Variable {.tabset}

OR(Y) = {1.1, 2} and OR(A) = 1

-   When A is used as the proxy the true $\phi$ = 1 (since selection depends on Y and not on the proxy)
    -   Thus, the original approach is unbiased with $\phi$ = 1   

-   When the role of A and Z2 are flipped, and Z2 is used to make the proxy, the true $\phi$ is somewhere between 0 and 1 since selection depends on both Y and the proxy
    -   In this specific simulation design, when the OR(Y) and OR(Z2) are both 1.1, then the true $\phi$ will be close to 0.5 and thus $\phi$~Uniform will produce essentially unbiased results (since the point estimate will correspond to $\phi$ = 0.5 with the Uniform prior)
    -   When OR(Y) = 2, $\phi$ is >0.5 (selection depends more strongly on Y than the proxy) so $\phi$~Uniform isn't close to unbiased

-   When A is not used at all, PPMM-Reg can still perform well because A isn't associated with selection (so ignoring it is okay). The true $\phi$ is somewhere between 0 and 1, and in the case when OR(Y) = 1.1 we again have true $\phi$ close to 0.5, so $\phi$~Uniform will produce essentially unbiased results. When OR(Y) = 2, the true $\phi$ is again >0.5 so there is some bias with $\phi$~Uniform.

#### Bias
```{r, fig.asp=0.5}
g_bias2
```

#### Coverage
```{r, fig.asp=0.5}
g_cov2
```

#### CI Width
```{r, fig.asp=0.5}
g_wid2
```

### Non-Ignorable, A is NOT a Shadow Variable {.tabset}

OR(Y) = {1.1, 2} and OR(A) = {1.1, 2}

-   Flipping A and Z2 will have similar performance as original when OR(A) = 1.1 b/c that is the same OR as for Z2
-   It will have different performance when OR(A) = 2 b/c that is different (larger) than the OR for Z2
-   PPMM-Reg ignoring A will be biased (regardless of $\phi$) since A is associated with selection
